metadata.notes: Observed 2026-09-20: manual compaction emits the full same-session working and ready lifecycle.

assessment.body: Current implementation: the DSH parser maps standalone compaction/start and compaction/end; inline numeric-turn markers remain skipped. The driver polls durable compaction/end with a deadline and fails on timeout or unreadable transcript. Fresh live verification remains required. Historical pre-fix recordings used a parser without these mappings and a fixed delay.
assessment.historical_body: Pre-fix assessment: the DSH parser skipped standalone compaction markers and the recipe used a fixed post-/compact delay. The committed historical recording therefore did not verify the required compact working-to-ready arc. This historical diagnosis does not describe current code.
caveats: Vacuous-pass condition: an unrelated DSH transcript could satisfy the lifecycle chain while this run never compacts. The fresh per-run cwd and the driver's pre-launch marker are load-bearing recipe inputs, and transcript assertions require exactly one compaction/start, compaction/summary, and compaction/end in the selected transcript.

Historical pre-fix diagnosis: the installed source exposed the marker pair; current parser and driver behavior require a fresh live recording for verification. The source explicitly appends the standalone marker pair, but record must confirm the installed TUI emits those records with the composed profile.

A tiny first turn can make `/compact` report `no compactable history yet` or reject a summary that is not smaller than the selected span. The recipe asks for 600 repeated tokens so the summary has a useful smaller target, and the transcript assertions fail if no compaction transaction occurs.

Load-bearing environment precondition: LM Studio must expose qwen/qwen3.5-9b at http://127.0.0.1:1234/v1, and the active TUI profile must still compose the compaction-basic service. The driver pins the endpoint and model, but record must re-probe both inputs.

The scenario requires zero tool calls. Both user prompts explicitly forbid tools, and the spec rejects every tool/call record. The auxiliary compaction request is an LLM request, not an agent tool call.

The scenario process says the agent emits a normal turn-end signal after compaction. DeepSeek Harness manual compaction instead emits compaction/end with turn:null. The marker is a more precise equivalent boundary, and the current parser maps it; fresh recording required.

sources.note: Installed TUI 0.8.1 lists `/compact` as `Summarize and compact session history` and dispatches it to actions.compact().
The TUI compact action invokes ctx.compaction.compactNow and distinguishes unavailable, running, no-history, success, and failure outcomes.

Official installed package reference: `/compact` condenses an older balanced span on demand, performs an auxiliary summary request, records the lifecycle in the session log, and lets the conversation continue.

compactSurfaceRegion appends compaction/start before summarization; the successful commit appends compaction/summary, a plugin-sourced replacement user/message, then compaction/end. compactNow uses owner:null and a durability flush.
compactCheckpointSource marks the replacement message as `{kind:'plugin', plugin:'compact'}`.
Current parser handlers map standalone compaction/start and compaction/end. The plugin checkpoint remains skipped because it is not a human prompt.
TestParserSkipsPluginUserMessage pins that a user/message with source.kind=plugin is skipped.
The adapter already tails the compressed transcript that contains the standalone compaction markers, so the missing arc is parser work rather than an observability limit.
DRIVE_ELICITS and dispatch implement wait_compaction. It polls the selected transcript for compaction/end and fails on deadline or unreadable input.

preconditions: dsh >=0.1.5-rc.2 is installed and on PATH
the community TUI profile is installed under the active DSH home and composes the compaction-basic service
LM Studio is listening at http://127.0.0.1:1234/v1 with qwen/qwen3.5-9b loaded
irrlichd is recording the deepseek-harness adapter with transcript permission granted
setup: The driver creates a fresh per-run cwd and a pre-launch marker, then launches `dsh --profile tui` under tmux.
The driver applies a temporary patch that selects LM Studio and qwen/qwen3.5-9b without modifying the installed profile.
The driver resolves only a post-marker session.v3.jsonl.zstd whose session header has the run cwd.

script.text: Do not use tools. Reply with the token alpha exactly 600 times, separated by one space. Output only those tokens.
Do not use tools. Reply with exactly this text and nothing else: STILL-HERE

verify: the same DSH session completes the priming ready-to-working-to-ready turn
the raw transcript contains one successful compaction/start, compaction/summary, compaction/end transaction
the same session enters working at compaction/start and returns to ready at compaction/end without waiting — current parser behavior; fresh live verification required
the post-compaction prompt completes ready-to-working-to-ready on the same session
the final session stays ready and the transcript contains no tool/call records
the recording reports qwen/qwen3.5-9b and non-zero tokens
recipe.scope_note: Uses the bounded wait_compaction transcript poll after `/compact`. The poll waits for durable compaction/end and fails on deadline or an unreadable transcript; it does not use a fixed compaction delay.
